output.brief: The GET slowdown is not caused by gateway 5.8. The regression began in each cell when storage fleet configuration change FC-7710 (the 2 Nov compaction tuning) was applied, not when the gateway arrived. In cell aps-3, which received 5.8 but skipped the config change, latency stayed at about 94 ms. Rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 changed nothing. On the storage nodes, compaction threads tripled, disk utilisation jumped from 41% to 97%, and disk queue wait rose from 9 to 205 ms, which explains the slower reads. I am fairly confident in this, though the link from Orrin's migration to the compaction backlog is still unattributed (attribution report due 10 Nov). Next: revert FC-7710 in one cell, watch p99 and backlog, then extend the revert. Do not roll back the gateway, since that would not fix this and would delay the SEC-2291 security fix due 30 Nov. Do not pause compaction, which risks disk-full nodes. Log the config push on the change calendar.
